title: Points Movement Limits Across the Wanderlane Traveller Club Tiers
content:
The desk reads three sets of limits against the Wanderlane Traveller Club tier held: what may leave the card by transfer, what a household pool may hold, and what may be bought outright.

## Transfer limits

The transfer column records whether points may be transferred to another member. The smallest transfer permitted and the largest total that may be transferred out in one calendar year are given in points, and the transfer fee is the fee per one thousand points transferred, in US dollars.

| Tier | Transfer of points | Smallest transfer, points | Largest transferred out in a calendar year, points | Transfer fee per one thousand points, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wanderlane Blue | not permitted | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Wanderlane Silver | not permitted | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Wanderlane Gold | permitted | 2000 | 30000 | 12.50 |
| Wanderlane Platinum | permitted | 1000 | 60000 | 10.00 |
| Wanderlane Titanium | permitted | 1000 | 120000 | 7.50 |
| Wanderlane Ambassador | permitted | 1000 | 250000 | 0.00 |

The smallest transfer permitted is 2000 points at Wanderlane Gold and 1000 points at each of Wanderlane Platinum, Wanderlane Titanium and Wanderlane Ambassador: the figure is read from the tier's own row of this schedule and not from the tier above or below it.

## Household pool

Pooling records whether the member may contribute to a household points pool, and the pool size is the largest number of memberships one household pool may hold.

| Tier | Contribution to a household pool | Largest memberships in one pool |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Wanderlane Blue | not permitted | 0 |
| Wanderlane Silver | not permitted | 0 |
| Wanderlane Gold | permitted | 5 |
| Wanderlane Platinum | permitted | 6 |
| Wanderlane Titanium | permitted | 8 |
| Wanderlane Ambassador | permitted | 10 |

## Purchase limits

Purchase records whether the member may buy points outright, at the price of one thousand purchased points in US dollars, up to the largest number of points that may be bought in one calendar year.

| Tier | Purchase of points | Price per one thousand points, USD | Largest bought in a calendar year, points |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wanderlane Blue | permitted | 35.00 | 60000 |
| Wanderlane Silver | permitted | 32.50 | 80000 |
| Wanderlane Gold | permitted | 30.00 | 100000 |
| Wanderlane Platinum | permitted | 27.50 | 150000 |
| Wanderlane Titanium | permitted | 25.00 | 200000 |
| Wanderlane Ambassador | permitted | 22.50 | 300000 |

Purchase is permitted at every tier of the programme, Wanderlane Blue included, where transfer and pooling are not.
